findings.issue: Iteration 10 is explicitly recorded as the cap, but production code was subsequently changed and published in iteration 13, and the workflow has now reached a nineteenth implementer tick. The current tick correctly made no production change, but another iteration would continue violating the governing stop condition.
findings.consequence: Further implementation in this workflow is unauthorized and would add post-cap work without the promised bounded review cycle.
findings.correction: Stop this loop after this review, preserve the published linear history without reset/revert/force operations, and carry product findings into a separately authorized run.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting security — mandatory idempotency for Super Admin tenant creation
findings.issue: POST /v1/platform/tenants remains replaySafe rather than idempotent. definePlatformRoute runs it when Idempotency-Key is absent, and route tests prove keyless creation is accepted. Retrying a lost keyless request without an explicit slug re-enters provisionTenant and its collision path chooses a random suffix, creating another property.
findings.consequence: One intended Super Admin action can create duplicate properties, owners, inventory, policy, and audit history.
findings.correction: Require Idempotency-Key on tenant creation, update all callers/tests to send one stable submission-scoped key, reject keyless requests, and prove a lost-response retry returns one property while the rendered form blocks in-flight duplicate submission.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — atomic, recoverable platform creation/idempotency
findings.issue: The platform reservation insert, create_tenant call, tenant initialization transaction, business result, and replay finalization are separate commits. There is no lease, durable operation-to-tenant identity, reconciliation, or compensation. Failures can leave a partial tenant or status=0 indefinitely; exact-key retry is then blocked while a fresh key can create a random-suffixed duplicate.
findings.consequence: Property creation can strand an unusable or partially initialized property, and recovery can duplicate it.
findings.correction: Execute creation, initialization, and idempotency completion atomically, or persist a unique operation identity with resumable phases and stale-operation recovery. Add fault-injection tests after create_tenant and after business commit but before replay finalization.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — recoverable local-auth person and owner onboarding
findings.location: apps/api/src/services/people.ts:15-37; apps/api/src/services/tenants.ts:43-55; apps/api/src/http.ts:117-119,206-208; apps/api/src/routes/people.ts:194-208,300-336; apps/web/src/screens/People.tsx:249-253; apps/web/src/screens/Platform.tsx:24-36; apps/web/src/screens/Auth.tsx:45-80,103-115; apps/api/test/api.test.ts:383-395
findings.issue: Local onboarding stores only a hash of a generated password and returns plaintext once, while both replay stores replace temporaryPassword with null. A lost first response leaves the created user without the sole credential; People/Platform then report an invitation even though local auth created none, and local auth has no recovery path.
findings.consequence: A tenant member, cross-property member, or new property's only owner can be permanently unable to sign in without database intervention.
findings.correction: Add a recoverable expiring setup/invitation flow or authenticated credential-reset flow with explicit replay semantics and no stored plaintext secret. Test lost-response retries for all three creation paths through successful first local sign-in.

findings.issue: Rendered tests execute Share/public-QR/attendant behavior and API tests separately cover two-hour expiry, HMAC rejection, and stored verify_code mismatch, but the joined test starts with a fabricated token, mounts GuestPass directly, replaces the scanner, and mocks lookup/redeem. No recorded execution joins server-generated bytes to the actual Share control, routed public page, decoded QR, and real gate validation.
findings.consequence: The exact artifact produced by the live resident flow has not been shown to survive sharing and redeem as the same valid pass.
findings.correction: In a separately authorized run, execute a routed mobile-browser story from live issue through Share, /pass#t=…, QR decode, and real lookup/redeem, asserting exact token identity, default two-hour unused expiry, HMAC tamper rejection, and stored verify_code mismatch rejection.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — real camera plate scanning at check-in and check-out
findings.issue: Rendered tests replace LiveCamera with a button that emits an already-decoded plate. No recorded run executes getUserMedia, the shipped ONNX loader/decoder, a camera fixture, and responsive browser rendering; the existing browser script covers check-in only.
findings.consequence: Actual camera acquisition/model decoding may fail before the covered downstream field wiring, and checkout camera behavior is not verified in the shipped stack.
findings.correction: In a separately authorized run, record 390x844 real-model fake-camera check-in and checkout stories, including visible filled fields, checkout match/result, browser/model/fixture versions, stopped tracks, and a clean console.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — complete real-stack CRUD and cross-property operations
findings.issue: The rendered suite mocks every API and completes a full lifecycle only for a unit; person is create-only, site/zone/slot coverage creates each and deletes only a slot, and cross-property coverage is one mocked member POST. No recorded execution joins the real routed UI/API for all entities or representative all-entity operations in a second property, and jsdom innerWidth does not verify responsive layout.
findings.consequence: Persisted all-entity administration, complete cross-property Super Admin behavior, server authorization boundaries, and narrow-screen usability remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: In a separately authorized run, execute complete person/site/unit/slot lifecycles through the real routed UI/API at a narrow viewport, perform representative all-entity operations in a second property as Super Admin, and prove regular-admin server denial.
